reasoning_content:
The boards serve process (45394) terminated after 6 minutes 54 seconds. In that log, boards isn't responding, but app and cms are up and running. The serve.mjs process terminates after the deadline (finishDevServers), but the dev server child process might still be alive ("still running, might just be slow"). The port is showing 000 (connection refused), which means the boards Vite dev server is either still building (Vite binds the port after the build completes) or it terminated.

The boards build takes about 65 seconds when done standalone. This time the 3rd concurrent build (with app + cms already occupying 2× ~1.3GB) is slower, and since memory is constrained... Let's check whether the boards build process is still running, and look at boards.log.

action.command: ps aux | grep -E "run-executor|urboards" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2,$4,$11,$12}' | head -5; echo "=== boards.log ==="; tail -6 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/boards.log; echo "=== serve-boards proc ==="; ps -p 45394 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo alive || echo exited
